events.title: Oasis's iconic debut 'Definitely Maybe'
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album Appreciation
angles.copy: Over three decades on, Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' still packs a punch. What's your go-to track from this Britpop classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Festival Flashback
angles.copy: Imagine three days of peace, love, and music. 57 years ago today, Woodstock began. What's your favourite live performance from the iconic festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us 49 years ago. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders remain timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond Fan Question
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who is your definitive 007 and why? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?
